records.title: Multi-modal mutual-guidance conditional prompt learning for vision-language models
records.reason: The full arXiv text describes MuGCP: an MLLM acts as conditional prompt learner, cached key/value states supply instance prompts, and experiments cover 14 vision-language datasets. It avoids fine-tuning large MLLMs, but its contribution is few-shot VLM classification/prompting rather than LLM inference serving or KV-cache reduction; the lineage connection is weak.

records.reason: Primary MDPI DOI https://doi.org/10.3390/s26051589 and publisher page could not be opened (internal error). The title/abstract indicate an ECG sparse temporal autoencoder, but the linked sparse-attention relevance cannot be checked against the full text.

records.title: MME: Mixture of Mesh Experts with Random Walk Transformer Gating
records.reason: The paper applies random-walk Transformer gating to mixture-of-experts for mesh analysis/classification. Its evaluations concern mesh classes and expert complementarity, not language models or serving efficiency.

records.title: GRAIL: Post-hoc Compensation by Linear Reconstruction for Compressed Networks
records.reason: GRAIL performs post-hoc blockwise linear reconstruction to compensate accuracy loss after structured network compression without labeled-data finetuning; the paper evaluates generic vision/network compression settings. It does not test LLMs or decode-time serving, so transfer to the linked weight-compression lineage is plausible but unresolved.

records.title: Causal Mechanism Reduction: Mechanism Replacement for Neural Network Pruning and Abstraction
records.reason: Causal Mechanism Reduction replaces selected internal mechanisms and connects causal abstraction with structured pruning, producing compact deployable networks in its evaluated tasks. It is not LLM-specific and reports no language-model inference deployment results; the pruning connection is indirect.
